benchmark_candidates.name: HELMET
benchmark_candidates.role: application-centered development subset and declared final categories

benchmark_candidates.name: LongBench Pro
benchmark_candidates.role: natural long-context tasks in declared language/length scope

benchmark_candidates.name: LongMemEval
benchmark_candidates.role: history and update evaluation; version/payload pinned before use

benchmark_candidates.name: RULER
benchmark_candidates.role: retrieval diagnostic, never sole useful-context evidence

identity_gate: Pin exact dataset/model/scorer versions, exclusions, language, length accounting, chat templates, judging settings and accepted subsets before outputs. Candidates are not downloaded or locally qualified by this plan.

scoring.primary: Average normalized task scores within each primary family, then give the two families equal weight; retain each family and task. Freeze mappings and weights before R2.
scoring.generation: Fixed answer budgets and decoding settings; report accuracy, grounded correctness, answerability/abstention, output tokens, truncation and latency. Separate judge inference, manual review and any external API spend.
scoring.general_retention: Freeze numerical short-task, language-loss and per-family margins using disjoint pilot inputs before confirmation; no headline while margins or useful-quality threshold are missing.
scoring.length: Same documents/questions where controllable, with explicit evidence-preserving views; natural benchmark length bins remain their own populations. Never silently truncate required evidence or rename a subset score as the official full benchmark.
scoring.difficulty: Include accessible and challenging items; oracle-evidence and short-context versions distinguish basic task inability from context failure. Record task exclusions before confirmation, not from final scores.

useful_context_gate: At a length, both primary families must clear their frozen absolute useful-quality floors and retention criteria at a fixed output budget; retrieval alone or allocated length cannot pass. Re-evaluate after post-training and export. Report failures and the highest passing tested length.

budget_ownership.pilot_and_study: R0/R1 diagnostics plus R4 formal core/transfer evaluation
budget_ownership.release: V1 final model and external comparisons

unopened_audits: Preserve legacy D5/E2 exclusions and independent new final tests; no new right to open a historical audit.
